data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in NEWT, USCB, and AVBH.

On September 14, 2026, NEWT filed an earnings release in an 8-K Item 2.02, Exhibit 99.1 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1587987/000162828026061720/a3q2026dividendannouncem.htm).

I’m Andrew, founder of Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only. I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
